task_title: README validation/test claims hold in a fresh public clone
task_criteria: From git clone https://github.com/dexdat/SpecLang.git at origin/main, following the README install+validate+test instructions exactly as written, each documented command exits with the status the README implies; where a command cannot pass as written the README is corrected to the real prerequisite/command or the claim is removed. Evidence: clone path, commands, exit codes, output pasted.

items.criterion: From git clone https://github.com/dexdat/SpecLang.git at origin/main, following the README install+validate+test instructions exactly as written, each documented command exits with the status the README implies; where a command cannot pass as written the README is corrected to the real prerequisite/command or the claim is removed. Evidence: clone path, commands, exit codes, output pasted.
items.detail: The README-25 commit (1a217abe, README.md only, 16+/13-) rewrote the validation/test claims, but the rewritten numbers do not match the commands the README tells the reader to run. Full suite at origin/main 4528a30e (TMPDIR=$PWD/.tmp npx vitest run, i.e. `npm test` minus the pretest build): EXIT=0, 'Test Files 121 passed | 4 skipped (125)' / 'Tests 2011 passed | 58 skipped (2069)' — README:166, README:748 and README:831 claim 'Tests 1995 passed | 58 skipped (2053), Test Files 120 passed | 4 skipped (124)' and README:732 says '2053-test suite'. README:579-581 says 'tests/ holds 124 test files ... 120 of the 124 files pass'; `git ls-tree -r --name-only origin/main tests | grep -E '\.test\.(ts|tsx)$' | wc -l` = 125. README:592 lists `tests/mcp/` as 4 files; origin/main tracks 5. README:396-398/409 say '--graph ... Nodes: 470 from 479 spec files'; actual `python3 scripts/generate_index.py --graph` prints 'Found 481 spec files' / 'Nodes: 472'. README:381-382 says `node bin/speclang status` prints 'Specs: 452 (450 .spec.md + 2 .scl)'; actual prints 'Specs: 453 (451 .spec.md + 2 .scl)'. No evidence transcript (clone path, commands, exit codes, pasted output) was committed — `git show --stat 1a217abe` shows only README.md. Many other documented commands do hold: validate_refs.py EXIT=0 'All references valid.'; validate_autonomous.py --project EXIT=0 with 464 'Validation Report' blocks, 464 PASSED, 0 FAILED, confidence 0.6-4.1; npx tsc --noEmit EXIT=0; npm run lint EXIT=0 (1 warning, src/ralph-loop/types.ts:11); npm run check:sqlite-binding EXIT=0; npx vitest run tests/parser.test.ts EXIT=0 (1 file/28 tests); npx vitest run tests/db EXIT=0 ('Test Files 9 passed (9)'); npx vitest run tests/e2e EXIT=0 (1 file/9 tests); the 3 integration files EXIT=0 (3 files/22 tests); npx tsx examples/hello-world/index.ts EXIT=0 'Hello, World!'; generate --dry-run EXIT=0; cascade EXIT=0; agent --dry-run EXIT=0; generate_index.py bare EXIT=2 and --tree without arg EXIT=2 as documented.

items.criterion: The test-suite counts the README states (tests passed/skipped, test files passed/skipped) match an actual full-suite run at origin/main.
items.detail: README:166/748/831 state 'Tests 1995 passed | 58 skipped (2053), Test Files 120 passed | 4 skipped (124)'. Actual run at HEAD 4528a30e (== origin/main): 'Test Files 121 passed | 4 skipped (125)' / 'Tests 2011 passed | 58 skipped (2069)', EXIT=0. Off by 16 tests and 1 file; README:732 repeats the stale '2053-test suite'.

items.criterion: The per-directory test-file counts in the README's 'Where the tests live' table match the files tracked at origin/main.
items.detail: README:592 lists `tests/mcp/` as 4 files; `git ls-tree -r --name-only origin/main tests/mcp` returns 5 (bin-path, commands, mcp-status-corrupt-db, metrics, server). All other rows verified correct against origin/main (cli 10, daemon 10, dashboard 16, db 8, cascade 6, cascade_new 3, maturity 5, autonomous 4, codegen 3, validation 4, performance 3, ci 2, meta 2, stdlib 2, agent-driver 1, agents/examples/transition/workflow 1 each, e2e 1).

items.criterion: The spec/index counts the README states (status Specs:, --graph Nodes:, spec-file count) match the commands the README tells the reader to run.
items.detail: README:396-398/409 claim '--graph ... Nodes: 470 from 479 spec files'; `python3 scripts/generate_index.py --graph` prints 'Found 481 spec files' and 'Nodes: 472' (EXIT=0). README:381-382 claims `node bin/speclang status` prints 'Specs: 452 (450 .spec.md + 2 .scl)'; actual output is 'Specs: 453 (451 .spec.md + 2 .scl)' (EXIT=0). README:579-581 claims 'tests/ holds 124 test files ... 120 of the 124 files pass'; origin/main tracks 125 and the run reports 121 passed + 4 skipped = 125.

items.criterion: The README's documented CLI commands that the commit touched (validate/generate/cascade/agent) exit with the status the README implies.
items.detail: ./bin/speclang --help EXIT=0; ./bin/speclang generate specs/examples.spec.dir/hello-world.spec.md --dry-run EXIT=0 with 'Mode: DRY RUN / Files written: 0 / Would generate: src/generated/hello-world.spec-hello-function.ts'; ./bin/speclang cascade specs/examples.spec.dir/hello-world.spec.md EXIT=0 with 'Cascade complete / Generated: 1 files / Converged: Yes / specs/generated/hello/function.ts'; ./bin/speclang agent --trigger specs/main.spec.md --dry-run EXIT=0; npx tsx examples/hello-world/index.ts EXIT=0 'Hello, World!'. Caveat recorded: README:113 './bin/speclang validate' exits 1 here ('Error validating .../specs/main.spec.md: No speclang-header declaration found', 452 passed / 1 failed) because of an untracked empty specs/main.spec.md that is not in origin/main, so that one command's fresh-clone status cannot be settled from this checkout.

items.criterion: The commit carries the evidence the task demands (clone path, commands, exit codes, pasted output) so the claim is reproducible.
items.detail: `git show --stat 1a217abe` shows only 'README.md | 29 ++++++++++++++-------------'; no clone path, command transcript, exit codes or pasted output were committed anywhere (no docs/ or evidence file in the commit). The asserted numbers are contradicted by a real run (2011/2069 vs claimed 1995/2053), so the claim is neither evidenced nor reproducible.
